name: San Jose
note: INLAND, and the first city to be so. No coastline, therefore no land mask: landFractionFor returns null and the whole footprint counts as land, which is correct. It sits at 1,160 m in the Valle Central, which is what forced cityFlatness — at that altitude the planet's procedural relief offers 345 m of hills over buildings 3-15 m tall.
_note_scope: SHIPPED AS THE CORE FIRST. Overpass throttled every mirror to roughly one tile a minute, so the full five-area metro is a multi-hour download. The core box below is what was already cached plus a handful more, and it holds all four districts the site drops you into. _fullAreas is the complete list: restore it over `areas`, re-run fetch-buildings (which resumes from .city-cache and only fetches what is missing) and then make-detail again, and the outer suburbs fill in without touching anything else.
